BrochureContent.Content:
Bowe Property presents to the market No. 6 Old Mill, Brownsmills, Kinsale, a truly beautiful home of enormous character, style, scale and substance within an unspoilt and historic countryside setting less than 2km from Kinsale town and 16km from Cork International Airport. Set within a private converted mill, with just six other private homes, Old Mill dates back to the 16th century with historic references from the battle of Kinsale. This home was completely curated within the protected structure in 2015 and now offers itself for sale as a truly unique home. The property has a total floor area of approx. 252sqm and accommodation is set over three floors, consisting of three bedrooms, all en-suite, together with a top floor den and luxurious family bathroom, as well as an open plan kitchen/dining/living area complimented by an enormous garden room with all the accommodation seamlessly linked by a welcoming entrance hall and overhead landing areas. No. 6 enjoys exquisite attention to detail in respect of hardwood flooring, marble bespoke tiling and countertops, luxurious bathrooms, open fireplaces, hand crafted kitchen cabinetry with premium appliances, a feature oversized island unit, extensive wall panelling with all rooms light filled with attractive six panel French style windows. The property benefits from gas fired central heating, mains water supply, high speed fibre optic broadband, all within a home that has been carefully finished to a high specification with very sympathetic and stylish appointment in every room. The property is truly unique, and is complimented by a fully landscaped garden offering superb privacy and space with an array of planted trees, shrubs, flowers and lawned area with a freshwater stream running through to the nearby saltwater creek. Within just 2km of Kinsale town and all of its wonderful, internationally renowned amenities- this home is a most unique and spectacular mill house that offers the best of Kinsale lifestyle living, a life of superior standard and style that is both appealing and comfortable.

Viewings are strictly by prior appointment and are now available.
